from solution import index_on_inner_list


def test_issue_example_index_zero():
    """Sort a list of lists by a given index of the inner list."""
    data = [('Greyson Fulton', 98, 99), ('Brady Kent', 97, 96), ('Wyatt Knott', 91, 94), ('Beau Turnbull', 94, 98)]
    expected = [('Beau Turnbull', 94, 98), ('Brady Kent', 97, 96), ('Greyson Fulton', 98, 99), ('Wyatt Knott', 91, 94)]  # 'Beau Turnbull' < 'Brady Kent' < 'Greyson Fulton' < 'Wyatt Knott'
    assert index_on_inner_list(data, 0) == expected


def test_issue_sort_by_middle_index():
    """Sort a list of lists by a given index of the inner list."""
    data = [('Greyson Fulton', 98, 99), ('Brady Kent', 97, 96), ('Wyatt Knott', 91, 94), ('Beau Turnbull', 94, 98)]
    expected = [('Wyatt Knott', 91, 94), ('Beau Turnbull', 94, 98), ('Brady Kent', 97, 96), ('Greyson Fulton', 98, 99)]  # 91 < 94 < 97 < 98 so Wyatt, Beau, Brady, Greyson
    assert index_on_inner_list(data, 1) == expected


def test_issue_sort_by_last_index():
    """Sort a list of lists by a given index of the inner list."""
    data = [('Greyson Fulton', 98, 99), ('Brady Kent', 97, 96), ('Wyatt Knott', 91, 94), ('Beau Turnbull', 94, 98)]
    expected = [('Wyatt Knott', 91, 94), ('Brady Kent', 97, 96), ('Beau Turnbull', 94, 98), ('Greyson Fulton', 98, 99)]  # 94 < 96 < 98 < 99 so Wyatt, Brady, Beau, Greyson
    assert index_on_inner_list(data, 2) == expected


def test_issue_numeric_order_not_lexicographic():
    """Sort a list of lists by a given index of the inner list."""
    data = [[3, 2], [10, 1], [1, 3]]
    expected = [[1, 3], [3, 2], [10, 1]]  # 1 < 3 < 10 numerically (lexicographically '10' < '3')
    assert index_on_inner_list(data, 0) == expected


def test_issue_empty_input():
    """Sort a list of lists by a given index of the inner list."""
    expected = []  # 0 rows in -> 0 rows out (0 == 0)
    assert index_on_inner_list([], 0) == expected


def test_issue_single_inner_list():
    """Sort a list of lists by a given index of the inner list."""
    expected = [[5, 6, 7]]  # single key 6 needs no ordering (6 == 6)
    assert index_on_inner_list([[5, 6, 7]], 1) == expected


def test_issue_inner_lists_as_lists():
    """Sort a list of lists by a given index of the inner list."""
    data = [['c', 3], ['a', 1], ['b', 2]]
    expected = [['a', 1], ['b', 2], ['c', 3]]  # 'a' < 'b' < 'c' so a(1), b(2), c(3)
    assert index_on_inner_list(data, 0) == expected


def test_issue_negative_values_ordering():
    """Sort a list of lists by a given index of the inner list."""
    data = [[0, -1], [0, -5], [0, 0]]
    expected = [[0, -5], [0, -1], [0, 0]]  # -5 < -1 < 0 so -5 + 4 = -1 and -1 + 1 = 0
    assert index_on_inner_list(data, 1) == expected


def test_contract_same_number_of_rows():
    """Sort a list of lists keeps every inner list."""
    data = [[2, 'y'], [1, 'x'], [3, 'z']]
    result = index_on_inner_list(data, 0)
    expected_len = 3  # 2 + 1 = 3 rows in -> 3 rows out
    assert len(result) == expected_len


def test_contract_inner_rows_preserved():
    """Sort a list of lists by a given index only reorders inner lists."""
    data = [[2, 'y'], [1, 'x']]
    expected = [[1, 'x'], [2, 'y']]  # 1 < 2 so [1,'x'] first, same objects 1+1=2 rows
    result = index_on_inner_list(data, 0)
    assert result == expected
    assert sorted(map(tuple, result)) == sorted(map(tuple, data))
